verdict.rationale: Viam documents logic modules that run on the machine to react to sensor data, coordinate components, run continuous processes and schedule actions, such as a threshold triggering a notification or a camera detection driving a motor. Inline modules let users write this code in the browser while Viam handles builds, versioning and deployment, which amounts to background automation the product itself provides. missing for 10: no-code/declarative trigger or scheduler configuration (automations require writing module code), detailed docs on scheduling semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
